description: Mutation-style Add-Car scenarios stressing ZIP formats, driver micro-phrases, and already_sent question-vs-statement intent (rule path; LLM off).

scenarios.name: 邮编无空格（第二泡）
scenarios.why_matters: WeChat typing often omits space after 邮编.

turns.text: 想加一台2024 Tesla Model Y，先帮我报个价
邮编95131，明天提车，就我一个人开

scenarios.name: zip 英文粘连
scenarios.why_matters: English zip label jammed against digits.

turns.text: 加车 2023 Honda CR-V，周五提车，我开，想报价

scenarios.name: 单泡：车型+邮编+驾驶人
scenarios.why_matters: Dense California Chinese bubble with 邮编 mid-sentence.

turns.text: 2024 Tesla，邮编95131，我自己开，下周三去dealer拿车，加进保单报个价

scenarios.name: 仅五位数邮编第二泡
scenarios.why_matters: Customer sends bare ZIP after being asked.

turns.text: 新车2023宝马X3，下周提车，我开，想加进保单报价

scenarios.name: 本人开 / 我一个人开
scenarios.why_matters: Short primary-driver phrases without 主要驾驶人.

turns.text: 要加一辆2021 RAV4，zip 91789，下周末提车

scenarios.name: 配偶驾驶
scenarios.why_matters: 老婆/老公 as primary driver colloquialism.

scenarios.name: 子女驾驶
scenarios.why_matters: 儿子/女儿 as driver phrase.

turns.text: 加车 2022 Lexus RX，90210，明天拿车

scenarios.name: 要不要先发给你（问句）
scenarios.why_matters: Question must not trigger false materials_sent handoff tone.

turns.text: 要加一辆2021 Toyota RAV4，zip 91789，下周末提车，我自己开
对了材料要不要先发给你
加车2024 Toyota Camry 92808 周五提车我开
要不我发你微信你看下行不行

scenarios.name: 已发陈述 + 截图
scenarios.why_matters: Strong already-sent cues should get verify-materials broker guidance.

turns.text: 加车2024 Toyota Camry 92808 周五提车我开
我已经发你微信了，截图发你了哈
